notes.title: Clash Release!
notes.notes:
[h2]"Clash" is now available on Steam![/h2]

[b]Dear all,

Finally, the MOBA developed by a small indie team is live on Steam. 
We want to emphasize that we're not expecting to profit from this game, nor are we seeking to compete with other MOBAs. Our goal in releasing it is simply to showcase the tremendous effort that went into making it a functional game. 
Even if it may not gain traction in the long run, we want you to relish every moment you spend playing because Clash offers a unique experience. It stands as proof to all indie studios that, with limited resources, it's possible to create a MOBA!

Now, let's see the DLCs milestones:[/b]


[h3][b]If we hit +44CCU(previous record) we will release the Mutant DLC for free:[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515130/Clash_Mutants_Vs_Pirates__Mutant_Pack/

[h3][b]If we hit 100CCU we will release the Pirate DLC for free:[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517130/Clash_Mutants_Vs_Pirates__Pirate_Pack/

[h3][b]If we hit 200CCU we will release the Kinvader DLC for free:[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517131/Clash_Mutants_Vs_Pirates__Kinvader_Pack/

[h3][b]+We will host Vs devs games on our discord:[/b][/h3]

https://discord.com/invite/ErhtpD4


See you in battle and thanks for your support!
NewGen Team

notes.title: Clash Release date annouced
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce the release of "Clash" on Steam this [b]Thursday, May 2, 2024, at 9 AM PT / 4 PM GMT.[/b] 

After addressing several bugs and enhancing the matchmaking system, we have balanced the champions and significantly improved the gameplay experience. 
Additionally, we have decided to make"Clash" [b]a free-to-play game[/b], which will include the [b]"Mutants DLC" at no additional cost.[/b]

This decision comes after multiple delays, and we see it as giving "Clash" one final opportunity to thrive on Steam. 
The future support and updates for the game will depend on player engagement and feedback. If we see substantial traction and a growing player base, we will continue to provide updates and support.

Ultimately, our goal with this release is to honor the nearly five years of dedication and hard work that went into developing "Clash," and to reward ourselves and our players with a game that truly reflects our efforts.

Custom rooms, public matchmaking, and party matchmaking will be available, so gather your friends and teams, and let’s play "Clash"!
---
Free Mutant Pack DLC on release date:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515130/Clash_Mutants_Vs_Pirates__Mutant_Pack/

notes.title: Patch Beta 0.73
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have been working on this early access version and improving it since last June and we are doing the last updates before the official release.

Here are the Update V0.73 notes:

-New Spectator Mode(Alpha) for custom games-Loading e-sport tournament event ;)
-New Playable Tutorial for new players.
-Reconnect and rejoin game feature (in case of internet cuts)
-New graphics and animated "Titles".
-Added 3 new emotes to Halyn.
-Added a new skin for Blaze.
-Dodge new mechanics (Press shift + direction key) "easier"
-Balancing a few things (like jumps consume less stamina 10%)
-Sound fx balancing and improving 3d sounds.
-Control SFX and champion voices in the Options menu.
-Many other bugs and glitches.
----------------
Coming up 
-Anti-cheat.
-Push to talk feature.


We will have an organized play session in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ErhtpD4]discord [/url]server tomorrow Wednesday and if any team wants to challenge the devs we will be ready for that :D.

Cheers!
